mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_room_member (room_id, member_id, member_type, member_name, agent_session_id) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{memberId}, #{memberType}, #{memberName}, #{agentSessionId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE member_name = VALUES(member_name), agent_session_id = VALUES(agent_session_id), is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT room_id, member_id, member_type, member_name, agent_session_id FROM ai_chat_room_member WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT room_id, member_id, member_type, member_name, agent_session_id FROM ai_chat_room_member WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND member_type = 'AGENT' AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT room_id, member_id, member_type, member_name, agent_session_id FROM ai_chat_room_member WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND member_type = 'CLIENT' AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT room_id, member_id, member_type, member_name, agent_session_id FROM ai_chat_room_member WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND member_type = 'CLIENT' AND is_deleted = 0 AND member_id IN
#{memberId}
SELECT room_id, member_id, member_type, member_name, agent_session_id FROM ai_chat_room_member WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_chat_room_member SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
